name: OpenEvidence
one_liner: OpenEvidence is an AI-powered clinical decision support tool that provides evidence-based answers to clinical questions with peer-reviewed citations in seconds.
best_for: Clinicians who need quick answers during patient encounters
Psychiatrists and prescribers checking medication interactions or guidelines
Mental health professionals researching evidence-based treatment approaches
Clinicians who want instant access to current research
not_for: Patients seeking self-diagnosis or treatment recommendations
Clinicians who require exhaustive systematic reviews
Those without clinical training to interpret the evidence
short_description: AI-powered clinical decision support with instant, evidence-based answers to clinical questions.
long_description: OpenEvidence is a clinical decision support tool designed to help healthcare providers find evidence-based answers to clinical questions quickly. Using AI to search and synthesize peer-reviewed literature, it provides answers with citations that clinicians can verify. The platform is particularly useful during patient encounters when quick access to current research is needed. Unlike traditional reference tools, OpenEvidence uses natural language processing to understand clinical questions and provide relevant, synthesized responses. It's designed to complement clinical judgment, not replace it, giving providers fast access to the evidence they need to make informed decisions.

pricing.notes: Free for clinicians. Premium features may require subscription.

privacy.notes: Designed for clinical use with appropriate privacy protections.

faqs.q: What is OpenEvidence and how does it work?
faqs.a: OpenEvidence is an AI-powered clinical decision support tool that uses natural language processing to understand clinical questions and search peer-reviewed literature. It synthesizes findings and provides answers with citations so clinicians can quickly access evidence during patient care.

faqs.q: Is OpenEvidence free for healthcare providers?
faqs.a: OpenEvidence offers free access for clinicians. The platform is designed for healthcare professionals and may offer premium features through subscription plans.

faqs.q: How accurate is OpenEvidence compared to UpToDate?
faqs.a: OpenEvidence and UpToDate serve different purposes. UpToDate provides curated expert-written summaries, while OpenEvidence uses AI to search and synthesize literature on-demand. Both cite sources, and many clinicians use both for different clinical needs.

faqs.q: Can I use OpenEvidence during patient appointments?
faqs.a: Yes, OpenEvidence is designed specifically for point-of-care use. Clinicians can quickly ask clinical questions and get evidence-based answers during patient encounters to support real-time decision-making.

how_clinicians_use_it: Quick medication interaction checks during prescribing
Looking up current treatment guidelines for specific conditions
Finding evidence for off-label medication uses
Answering patient questions about treatment options with citations
clinician.implementation_notes: Web-based platform requiring no integration. Can be accessed from any browser during patient encounters. Consider bookmarking for quick access.
